items.headline: AI loan investors demand covenants after CoreWeave leveraged-loan spread blows out 125bp
items.note: Lenders forcing covenant protections back into a leveraged loan is a concrete tightening of terms for AI-infrastructure debt, reversing the covenant-lite trend from earlier in the buildout.

items.headline: Loan investors push back on AI-exposed borrowers; CoreWeave, Proofpoint forced to sweeten terms to clear deals
items.note: Borrowers having to raise yields or add investor protections to place debt is a direct market signal of rising financing costs for AI-infrastructure credit.
